practiceReport.beatComment: Carmona returned to practice Wednesday as a limited participant in what was his first workout with the team since sustaining an ankle sprain in the Titans' Sept. 27 loss to the Giants. The Titans will have a 21-day window to evaluate him in practice, but once Carmona is deemed ready to return from IR, he could step into a starting role at either left or right guard.

practiceReport.beatComment: Adams was added to the Titans' injury report right before the 1 p.m. ET kickoff due to the illness, and the veteran safety wasn't able to take any snaps before being ruled out for Sunday's contest. Terrell Burgess drew the start at safety alongside Kevin Winston in Adams' absence, per Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Fernando Carmona
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 9 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Carmona returned to practice Wednesday as a limited participant in what was his first workout with the team since sustaining an ankle sprain in the Titans' Sept. 27 loss to the Giants. The Titans will have a 21-day window to evaluate him in practice, but once Carmona is deemed ready to return from IR, he could step into a starting role at either left or right guard.

irAndReserveTracker.name: James Williams Sr.
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: In a corresponding transaction, Tennessee activated linebacker Dorian Mausi from injured reserve. Williams won't be able to return to game action until Week 14 against the Lions at the earliest. In the meantime, Mausi figures to assume the small role Williams was occupying.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Peter Skoronski
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Skoronski was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to a hamstring injury that he picked up in Week 8 against the Bengals. Now that he's on IR, the fourth-year offensive lineman will be required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 14 against the Lions on Sunday, Dec. 13. James Hudson and Garrett Dellinger figure to be the top candidates to start at left guard in Skoronski's absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tommy Townsend
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Townsend suffered a knee injury during the Week 7 loss to Cleveland and is also now dealing with an Achilles issue. His placement on IR means he'll be sidelined for at least four games. Thomas Morstead was signed by Tennessee from the practice squad to the active roster to take Townsend's role as the team's punter.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyjae Spears
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Spears was sidelined for Weeks 7 and 8 due to a knee injury but was cleared to play against the Jaguars in Week 10, when he turned four carries into 28 yards and failed to haul in his lone target. He was initially listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys after logging a full practice Friday, but the Titans have determined that a stint on injured reserve is warranted for the fourth-year running back. Spears will be required to miss at least the next four games, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Colts on Sunday, Dec. 20. Tony Pollard will continue to be the workhorse running back for the Titans while Julius Chestnut and rookie fifth-rounder Nicholas Singleton provide depth out of the backfield.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jackson Slater
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 9 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Slater sustained a serious foot injury during Sunday's game against the Giants, and his immediate backup, Fernando Carmona (ankle), was also hurt when he stepped into Slater's place. Both will have to miss at least Tennessee's next four games, potentially leaving free-agent acquisition Atonio Mafi or rookie sixth-rounder Pat Coogan as starting options at right guard.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jaren Kanak
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jaylen Harrell
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Harrell is being monitored following Saturday's accident. The third-year pro tore his ACL in a preseason game against the 49ers in mid-August, which led to him being placed on season-ending injured reserve.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kendell Brooks
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: It's currently unclear what issue Brooks is dealing with, but he was waived/injured Sunday and subsequently cleared waivers. As such, he's been placed on season-ending IR. Brooks could still play in 2026, though, if he works out an injury settlement with the Titans.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tanoh Kpassagnon
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Kpassagnon is suffering from an unknown issue. The defensive end will now spend the entirety of the 2026 regular season on injured reserve unless he is waived with an injury settlement.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Meanwhile Carnell Tate (shoulder) is slated to practice this week, and his potential return to action this weekend against Dallas figures to impact the playing time of Elic Ayomanor and Chimere Dike. Robinson's looming absence will free up snaps/targets in the slot, with Saleh noting Wednesday that he's looking forward to seeing what rookie slot option Xavier Restrepo can do with added opportunities going forward.
